donnees.titre: AEGIS P15: Ocular Disease Recognition Augmenting System (ORAS)
donnees.revue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
donnees.resume: AEGIS P15: Ocular Disease Recognition Augmenting System (ORAS) presents a deep-learning ensemble for automated detection of four major ocular diseases — Diabetic Retinopathy (AUC 0.977), Age-related Macular Degeneration (AUC 0.953), Glaucoma (AUC 0.899), and Hypertensive Retinopathy (AUC 0.993) — from fundus photographs. The system employs four dedicated specialist models, surpassing the ODIR benchmark baseline. AEGIS ORAS is part of the AEGIS Human-AI Augmenting System suite. Full interactive application and all AEGIS projects are available at https://aegishumanai.com
